## Purpose / 修改目的

Describe the problem and affected skill. 说明问题与相关 Skill。

## Changes / 变更

Describe the final behavior and any installation or dependency changes. 说明最终行为及安装、依赖变化。

## Validation / 验证

List commands or manual checks and their results. Mark project-specific rendering, deployment or hardware work that was not performed. 列出检查命令及结果，说明尚未进行的具体项目验证。

## Related issue / 关联 Issue

Closes # (if applicable / 如适用)

- [ ] English and Chinese instructions or references are updated together where relevant. 已同步相关中英文内容。
- [ ] Inputs and examples are shareable, with no secrets or private project material. 输入与示例可公开，不含密钥或私有项目资料。
